title: Vektra Logistics
summary: Vektra is a brand identity built for a logistics company aiming to compete on reliability rather than scale.

blocks.body: Vektra is a brand identity built for a logistics company aiming to compete on reliability rather than scale. The project covers the full identity system naming, logomark, typography, colour, and a campaign-ready visual language, designed to feel confident, modern, and distinct from the blue-and-white conventions of the freight industry.
